title: From <g>New Lead</g>
to Booked Call
subtitle: Four steps. Only one of them is mine.

cards.title: A lead comes in
cards.body: The system notices it. No one has to check.

cards.title: AI writes the reply
cards.body: In my voice, from my best past messages.

cards.title: I say yes
cards.body: One click to approve, edit or reject.

cards.title: It goes out
cards.body: Sent and tracked. Checked again in 5 days.

payoff.text: A booked call, in my words
